entries.text: Did you manage to catch an Alolan Form\nPokémon for me?
entries.label: sdc02_0080_teacher_01

entries.text: Keep searching and I’m sure you’ll find one.\nJust imagine you’re out on a nice stroll in Alola!
entries.label: sdc02_0080_teacher_02

entries.text: Ahhh, regrettably, that is not an Alolan Form\nPokémon...
entries.label: sdc02_0080_teacher_03

entries.text: That’s one, all right! You have, without a doubt,\ngot yourself an Alolan [VAR 0x0101(0001)]!
entries.label: sdc02_0080_teacher_04

entries.text: It’s able to glide about by concentrating its\npsychic power in its tail. This Pokémon has\r\nsometimes been called “hodad” as well!
entries.label: sdc02_0080_teacher_05

entries.text: It wobbles the metallic whiskers that sprout from\nits head to communicate with its comrades!
entries.label: sdc02_0080_teacher_06

entries.text: Its shining gold whiskers are advanced sensors\nthat can detect sounds from miles away!
entries.label: sdc02_0080_teacher_07

entries.text: It’s impulsive, selfish, and fickle—but it’s popular\nwith Trainers who like pouring affection on it.
entries.label: sdc02_0080_teacher_08

entries.text: It’s got formidable physical strength, but it’s also\ngot an adorable round face and silky-smooth\r\ncoat that make it mighty popular in Alola!
entries.label: sdc02_0080_teacher_09

entries.text: See, Grimer were brought over to Alola to solve\nthe garbage disposal problems there. Over time,\r\nthe Grimer ended up in this form!
entries.label: sdc02_0080_teacher_10

entries.text: This is a dangerous one! Those things that look\nlike fangs and claws are actually crystallized\r\npoison—touch one, and it’ll afflict you at once!
entries.label: sdc02_0080_teacher_11

entries.text: They say that as Exeggutor grew taller and taller,\nit outgrew its reliance on psychic abilities, and\r\nthe power of the sleeping dragon within it awoke!
entries.label: sdc02_0080_teacher_12

entries.text: It exhales air colder than −58 degrees\nFahrenheit! It’s also sometimes known by\r\nan older name: Keokeo.
entries.label: sdc02_0080_teacher_13

entries.text: It lives deep in the snowy mountains and creates\ndrops of ice in its coat. It even used to be\r\nworshiped as a deity incarnate!
entries.label: sdc02_0080_teacher_14

entries.text: It lives deep in mountainous areas that are\nburied in snow. It’s got a soft belly, but the ice\r\non its back is as hard as steel!
entries.label: sdc02_0080_teacher_15

entries.text: It has developed thick, sharp claws that allow it\nto dash at high speeds even across snowy plains!
entries.label: sdc02_0080_teacher_16

entries.text: Its body is actually a magnetic stone! Iron sand\ngets stuck to the bits that have especially\r\nstrong magnetism.
entries.label: sdc02_0080_teacher_17

entries.text: The stones it likes to eat have caused its whole\nbody to become electrified. It’s got a real\r\ntemper too!
entries.label: sdc02_0080_teacher_18

entries.text: It’s grumpy and stubborn. Upset it, and it’ll let\nout an electric charge and thunder-like growl!
entries.label: sdc02_0080_teacher_19

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Wait—[VAR 0x0100(0000)],
you
already
finished
the
assignment?![VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0080_fairybb_01

entries.text: I was really motivated!
entries.label: sdc02_0080_select_01

entries.text: It was a walk in the park!
entries.label: sdc02_0080_select_02

entries.text: So battling isn’t your only talent, then—you’ve\ngot a knack for catching Pokémon too![VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0080_fairybb_02

entries.text: It’s easy to see how high level the students must\nbe at Naranja Academy![VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0080_fairybb_03

entries.text: It’s easy to see how high level the students must\nbe at Uva Academy![VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0080_fairybb_04

entries.text: All right, everyone! Gather round!
entries.label: sdc02_0080_teacher_20

entries.text: We’re all out of time for today, so that’ll have to\nbe it for this class session.
entries.label: sdc02_0080_teacher_21

entries.text: If you didn’t manage to catch a Pokémon in time,\nthat’ll be your homework to complete before our\r\nnext session. Class dismissed!
entries.label: sdc02_0080_teacher_22

entries.text: Maaan, really? Guess I’m stuck with homework.
entries.label: sdc02_0080_mob_01

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]So, [VAR 0x0100(0000)],
what
did
you
think
of
your
first
Blueberry
class?[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0080_fairybb_05

entries.text: It was fun!
entries.label: sdc02_0080_select_03

entries.text: It was easy!
entries.label: sdc02_0080_select_04

entries.text: Really?! It makes me so happy to hear that![VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0080_fairybb_06

entries.text: My word, so the classes at your academy are\neven more demanding?[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0080_fairybb_07

entries.text: Oh! I was supposed to go make an appearance\nat the clubroom! Shoot![VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0080_fairybb_08

entries.text: I’m afraid this will have to be the end of our little\ntour, but let me leave you with one more tip![VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0080_fairybb_09

entries.text: Here at Blueberry, we have lots of extracurricular\ntasks you can do called [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Blueberry Quests[VAR 0xFF00(0000)], or just\r\n[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]BBQs[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] for short![VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0080_fairybb_10

entries.text: They’re sort of like missions that the school\nassigns to students out and about in the Terarium.[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0080_fairybb_15

entries.text: You might be asked to have your Pokémon do\nsome Auto Battles or to catch specific Pokémon.\r\nThose sorts of things![VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0080_fairybb_16

entries.text: You never know what the next BBQ might be or\nwhere you’ll need to go to carry it out.[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0080_fairybb_17

entries.text: But if you can do what’s asked of you, you’ll earn\n[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Blueberry Points[VAR 0xFF00(0000)], also called [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]BP[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0080_fairybb_18

entries.text:
BP is a kind of school currency you can use in the
[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]cafeteria[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] or at the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]school store[VAR 0xFF00(0000)].\c
You might be able to use it for [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]club activities [VAR 0xFF00(0000)]in
the future too...[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0080_fairybb_11

entries.text: Anyway! The long and the short of it is that you\nshould do BBQs and get yourself BP![VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0080_fairybb_12

entries.text: And that’s it from me![VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0080_fairybb_13

entries.text: Sorry for having to dash, but I really must be off\nnow—enjoy your time at Blueberry Academy![VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0080_fairybb_14

entries.text:
You aren’t quite ready to progress further in the
adventure awaiting you at Blueberry Academy!\c
To do so, you’ll need to have first completed
your main adventure in the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Paldea region[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] by
completing the professor’s last task, as well as
conclude the assignment you were given during
your school trip to the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]land of Kitakami[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]!
entries.label: sdc02_0080_system_01
